author: XSolaris
what_it_is: On Disk One, Aeris, Cloud, and Tifa at Lvl 99, with everybody else's level around 85. Cloud has Omnislash, Aeris has Great Gospal, Aeris, Cloud, and Tifa each have a Champion Belt. Several materias mastered.
